card.name: The word "among" introducing a group
card.fires_on: The word "among" (or "Among"), either opening a sentence or following a noun such as deaths, tensions or vary. It is followed by a group of people or things.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Among
modes.description: "Among" begins a sentence and introduces a group, often before "the" or "other".
modes.example: <<Among>> the prominent pioneers of this locality were the

modes.label: Mid-sentence among
modes.description: "among" follows a noun or verb and links it to a group, such as men, patients or experts.
modes.example: More than half of all premature deaths<< among>> men are preventable.

card.writes: It promotes "among" and "amongst" and similar words, so it supports the same word continuing a group phrase.
card.plain: It fires on the word "among" when it points to a group, such as "deaths among men" or "Among patients".
